# @trysac/etag-conditional

> ETags and conditional requests for TypeScript APIs per RFC 9110: strong and weak comparison, If-Match, If-None-Match and date preconditions in the standard order, with 304 and 412 results TypeScript library for Node.js 20+, published as ES modules with type declarations. MIT.
